Summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) consume significantly more energy per successful task than conventional AI systems, with a 70-billion-parameter LLM using around 348.41 watt-hours per query. The energy use varies greatly depending on model size and task complexity. Energy consumption per query can range from fractions of a watt-hour to several kilowatt-hours.
